image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dessert on a white plate. The dish features pieces of sponge cake or bread pudding heavily coated in a thick, dark brown chocolate sauce. A slice of strawberry is visible embedded in the sauce and cake. The sauce pools around the base of the dessert and coats the top surfaces with a glossy sheen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thick, glossy liquid condiment with deep brown to dark chocolate coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays a dark brown substance with a distinct glossy finish, consistent with chocolate sauce.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth, reflective sheen with viscous, syrupy consistency.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Highlights on the surface of the sauce indicate a smooth, wet texture. The way it clings to the cake and pools suggests high viscosity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forms ribbons that gradually level out when poured.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a static shot of the final plated dish; the action of pouring and the formation of ribbons during that process are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform texture with no visible particulates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sauce appears homogeneous and smooth, without visible chunks of cocoa or other solids within the liquid itself.
The sauce maintains its shape on the vertical sides of the cake and forms thick pools rather than spreading thinly, indicating slow-flowing viscosity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface tension creates slight meniscus at container edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Where the sauce meets the white plate, there is a defined edge and slight curvature consistent with surface tension of a viscous fluid.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Color ranges from rich mahogany to near-black depending on cocoa concentration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color is a deep, dark brown, fitting the description of rich mahogany to near-black.
Specular highlights are clearly visible on the curves of the sauce, confirming a glossy surface.
The context of cake and fruit on a plate confirms its role as a dessert condiment.

alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints are fully present. The image perfectly captures the visual characteristics of chocolate sauce: viscosity, gloss, color, and texture. The one non-testable checkpoint (pouring action) does not detract from the class conformance of the static subject.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. The textures of the cake, fruit, and sauce are physically consistent. Lighting and reflections are natural. Boundaries between the sauce and the plate are sharp and realistic.
